This rapid and sustained growth in sales indicates a strong market position and potential for future expansion. The sector median sales growth at 10.1% [E60] further supports this by highlighting how Esha Media Research Ltd outperforms its peers, making it a compelling investment opportunity despite some negative indicators such as the negative price-to-book ratio.
